hero.headline: Websites that work for your success
hero.sub: From design to domain, hosting, ads and traffic reports — I guide you every step of the way.

offer.title: What I can do for you
offer.sub: From the first idea to a live website — I guide you step by step, in plain language.

items.title: Business card website
items.desc: A simple site for your company online: who you are, what you do, and how to reach you. Perfect when you just need to be findable on the internet.

items.title: Landing page
items.desc: One short page built for a single result — a phone call, a sign-up, or a sale. Works especially well with Google ads.

items.title: Online shop
items.desc: A place where customers browse products, add them to a cart, and pay online. You get a panel to add and edit offers yourself.

items.title: WordPress website
items.desc: WordPress is a popular way to run a website so you can change texts and photos yourself — without coding. I build it so it’s easy for you to manage later.

items.title: Blog
items.desc: A place for articles and tips about your industry. It builds trust and helps customers find you more easily in Google.

items.title: Consulting & technical support
items.desc: I’ll help you choose sensible solutions and explain them in simple terms. After launch I can handle fixes, updates, and step in when something doesn’t work.

extras: Domain registration & renewal (your web address, e.g. yourcompany.com)
Hosting — the place on the internet where your site is stored
Simple reports: who visits your website

portfolio.title: Projects
portfolio.sub: Selected work for small and medium businesses.

process.title: How we work together
process.sub: A simple process with full transparency at every stage — no jargon, no surprises.

steps.title: Kickoff chat
steps.desc: In a relaxed conversation we learn about your business, the goal of the website, and who it should reach. We agree on the scope of work and an approximate timeline. Photos, graphics, logos, and texts are welcome — if you don’t have them, I’ll prepare or generate them for you.

steps.title: Look & feel
steps.desc: I guide you through the conversation and gather detailed preferences: what you like, what we’re aiming for, and how your site should look and feel. After that chat I need about a week to prepare the first visual template, which I present for your approval.

steps.title: Build & go live
steps.desc: I build the website, set up your web address (domain), hosting, and business emails. I check that everything works on phone, tablet, and computer — then the site is ready to show the world.

steps.title: Ongoing support
steps.desc: After launch you get one month of care included in the package — during that time you can still request edits and tweaks. I also help with updates, ads, and explain traffic reports in plain language.

contact.title: Let's build something together
contact.sub: Have an idea for a website? Write to me and I'll respond within 24 hours.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how the AddPattern website (the “Site”) uses cookies and similar technologies (such as localStorage). It is informational and applies to the Site operated by AddPattern Marcin Krzysztoszek (Tax ID / NIP: 8262179582).

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: The controller of the Site and of data related to cookies / browser storage is AddPattern Marcin Krzysztoszek, Warsaw, Poland.

sections.title: 2. What cookies and similar technologies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by the browser when you visit websites. They may be used to make the Site work, remember preferences, or collect statistics.
Similar technologies (e.g. localStorage, sessionStorage) can also store information in your browser. In this Policy we refer jointly to cookies and such mechanisms where they are used on the Site.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
paragraphs: Use of necessary technologies required for the Site to function properly is based on the controller’s legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) and rules on electronic services.

Analytics cookies (Google Analytics 4) are used only after your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw consent at any time in the Site footer (“Cookie settings”) or by rejecting cookies in the banner.

sections.title: 4. Technologies we currently use
list: Language preference (localStorage) — remembering the selected interface language (PL/EN) via i18next so the Site can show your preferred language on the next visit.
Cookie consent (localStorage) — storing your “accept” / “essential only” choice so we do not ask on every visit.

Google Analytics 4 — the Site includes the Google tag (gtag.js) with consent mode: analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_*) and visit measurement are enabled only after you give consent. The tool is not used for ads. Google LLC may process data under its own privacy policy.

Browser technical data — while you use the Site, the browser may process data needed for the connection (e.g. IP address, browser type, operating system). These are standard network/hosting logs, not marketing profiling by the Site.
Google Fonts — the Site loads fonts from Google servers (fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com). The provider may process technical connection data under Google’s own privacy policy.

sections.title: 5. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: The technologies described in this Policy are used only to:
list: ensure the Site displays and works correctly,
analyse site traffic (Google Analytics 4) — only after consent,
handle user inquiries (e.g. email contact — outside the cookie mechanism).

sections.title: 6. Retention period
paragraphs: The language preference stored in localStorage remains until you remove it (by clearing site data in the browser) or change the language on the Site.
The cookie-consent choice (localStorage) remains until you change it on the Site or clear site data.
Google Analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_*) are typically stored for up to 24 months, according to Google Analytics settings.
Technical data on the hosting / infrastructure side may be retained according to server logs and that provider’s policy.

sections.title: 7. Recipients / third parties
paragraphs: In connection with operating the Site, technical data may be processed by:
list: the hosting / publishing provider (e.g. GitHub Pages),
Google LLC — Google Fonts and, after consent, Google Analytics 4,
the email provider — only when you initiate email contact yourself.

sections.title: 8. Transfers outside the EEA
paragraphs: Using services based outside the European Economic Area (e.g. Google, GitHub) may involve transferring technical data outside the EEA. In such cases, safeguards provided by law (including standard contractual clauses) apply, in line with those providers’ policies.

sections.title: 9. How to manage cookies and browser data
paragraphs: You can manage cookies and site data at any time in your browser settings, including blocking storage or deleting data already saved. Example locations:
list: Google Chrome — Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
Microsoft Edge — Settings → Cookies and site permissions
Mobile devices — browser or system privacy settings
paragraphsAfter: You can change analytics consent in the Site footer (“Cookie settings”). Restricting necessary technologies may affect some Site features (e.g. remembering the selected language).

sections.title: 10. Your rights
paragraphs: To the extent cookies or similar technologies involve personal data processing, you have rights under the GDPR, including access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (in Poland: the President of the Personal Data Protection Office — UODO).
For questions about this Policy, contact: kontakt@addpattern.pl

sections.title: 11. Changes to this Cookie Policy
paragraphs: This Policy may be updated, for example when new tools (analytics, marketing) are added to the Site or when the law changes. The updated version will be published on this page with the last updated date.

devs.name: Marcin Krzysztoszek
devs.about: Full-stack developer with 4+ years of experience building applications that genuinely improve business processes — from B2B shops and warehouse systems (WMS) to invoice workflow automation. Day to day I work with React, TypeScript and Node.js plus AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to ship quality faster. I’m not afraid of other technologies — I’m also comfortable navigating .NET and PHP. I’m open to growing toward new technologies. In a team, what matters to me is clear communication and hybrid/remote work.
devs.stackLegend: Technologies outlined in the brighter border are ones I use every day.

bullets: Designed and deployed TurboFinder — B2B shop for turbochargers (React, Node.js, Express, MySQL).
Built AgroFinder — agricultural parts shop with multi-path search and cascading filters.
Created Management Dashboard — real-time reporting of stock and inventory statistics.
Co-developed WMS — warehouse management and inventory system (C# / ASP.NET, SQL).
Implemented a low-code solution (Suncode / PlusWorkflow) for invoice approval workflows and KSeF integration.
Ran cybersecurity awareness training on KnowBe4 and phishing campaigns to raise employee security awareness.
Administered Microsoft services (licenses, accounts) and handled device setup and onboarding for new users.
Delivered business card sites and landing pages for the sales department.
Maintained and developed legacy code (PHP, jQuery) in older company systems.
Design and deployment of websites for local businesses — WordPress and hand-crafted solutions.
Direct client collaboration: requirements gathering, deployment, CMS training.
Full setup: domain registration, hosting configuration, business email addresses.
Running Google Ads campaigns and delivering traffic reports to clients.
